opening.argument: The speaker tests survey and task apps against eight hours of minimum-wage work, then reports earning $17.11 after eight hours on the apps. He also explains that cash-out thresholds prevent him from withdrawing much of that amount. His conclusion is direct: the apps are not worth his time. That first-person comparison gives viewers a critical assessment of the earnings claims, not a promise that the apps will pay well. The Webull partnership concerns a separate stock-investing app, and the reference identifies no established deceptive conduct connecting that promotion or the closing subscription request to the apps tested.
